description: Decompile a PDF into Markdown (headings, lists, tables, math as LaTeX) locally. Born-digital pages take milliseconds; scans and screenshots get on-device OCR only where needed. Nothing is uploaded. Use pdf_outline first on long documents to pick pages.

maxChars.description: Truncate the Markdown to this many characters (default 200000)

ocr.description: Escalate ink the text layer cannot explain to on-device OCR (default true)

path.description: Path to a PDF on this machine

url.description: URL of a PDF to fetch

name: pdf_to_markdown
title: PDF → Markdown
